name: loctree
description: Structural code intelligence for AI agents. Scan once, query everything: dependency graphs, blast radius, dead exports, circular imports, duplicate surfaces and exact occurrences — so an agent orients before it edits. loctree-suite is the integration repo for the whole product line: the loctree engine and loct CLI, the loctree-mcp MCP server, and the loctree-lsp language server.

tools.name: context
tools.description: Complete Agent Context Pack: structural + runtime + risk + action + authority, with optional AICX memory. The session-start surface.

tools.name: repo-view
tools.description: Repository overview: file count, LOC, languages, health summary, top hubs, quick wins.

tools.name: slice
tools.description: File context before modifying: the file plus every import it pulls and every file that depends on it.

tools.name: body
tools.description: Bounded source body/range for a symbol, with extent and truncation metadata.

tools.name: find
tools.description: Symbol, importer and occurrence search. Modes: symbols, who-imports, where-symbol, tagmap, crowd, literal.

tools.name: impact
tools.description: Blast radius before deleting or refactoring: direct and transitive consumers of a file.

tools.name: diff
tools.description: Compare the live snapshot against a git ref: file, graph, export and impact changes.

tools.name: tree
tools.description: Directory structure with LOC counts, filters, artifact detection.

tools.name: focus
tools.description: Understand a module: files, exports, internal edges, external dependencies, optional consumers.

tools.name: follow
tools.description: Pursue structural signals: dead, cycles, twins, hotspots, trace, commands, events, pipelines.

tools.name: suppressions
tools.description: Source-side silencer inventory: Rust #[allow]/#[ignore]/unsafe, nosemgrep, @ts-ignore, eslint-disable, noqa, type: ignore, shellcheck disable.

tools.name: prism
tools.description: Score conceptual smear across task framings; emits the loctree.prism.v1 schema.
